question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Evasive
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word '**Evasive**' means trying to avoid something; not direct.(टालने वाला)

 
 
• **Example**-His answers were evasive and didn't address the real issue.
 
 
 
• "**Ambiguous" **means having more than one possible meaning, unclear or confusing.(अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example**-He gives an ambiguous answer to his initial question.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that synonym of '**evasive**' is '**ambiguous**'.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is **Ambiguous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences:

 
• **Cohesive**(जोड़नेवाला): united and working together effectively

 
 
• **Example**-A **cohesive **team works well together and supports each other.
 
 
 
• **Accessible**(पहुंच योग्य): possible to be reached or entered
 
 
• **Example**-The site is **accessible **by a choice of means of transport.
 
 
 
• **Abrasive**(अपघर्षक): rough and likely to scratch
 
 
• **Example**-The wood should be rubbed down with fine **abrasive **paper.
 
 

3a:Tba8,

The correct answer is **Option 3**</p&
